title: Brazilian soft-commodity facilities and cooperative membership
description:
Facility and membership layers for Brazilian soft-commodity supply chains: one
unified layer plus the six component layers it is built from. All geometry is
WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

## The files

- **`BR_facilities`** - the unified layer, every entity as one row across all
  tiers (40,669 rows: 32,309 points and 8,360 polygons). This is the one to
  start with. Columns: `entity_id, entity_kind, tier, weight, basis,
  geom_method, source, geometry`.
- **`BR_intake_points`** - grain silos from CONAB (18,802): cooperative, trader,
  and official, with registered coordinates and static capacity in tonnes.
- **`BR_sisbi_points`** - state/municipal (SISBI) slaughterhouses & dairy plants
  (11,582), the frontier long tail, via Trase, with `inspection_level`
  (SIE/SIM/CONSORCIO).
- **`BR_muni`** - IBGE municipality boundaries (5,570), the geography everything
  keys to.
- **`BR_membership_muni`** - cooperative-member farm counts per municipio
  (5,257), joined to municipality polygons.
- **`BR_buyer_points`** - federal (SIF) slaughterhouses & dairy plants (1,514),
  geocoded, tagged by commodity (beef/poultry/pork/dairy).
- **`BR_mill_points`** - sugar/ethanol mills from ANP (417), town-centroid,
  with production capacity in cubic metres per day.

The seven files hold 83,811 rows between them, but `BR_facilities` is a union of
the other six plus the modelled catchments, so the number of distinct entities
is 40,669. Do not add the seven row counts together and call the result a
facility count.

## Tiers (in `BR_facilities.tier`)

Measured over all 40,669 rows: `intake_point` grain silos (18,796),
`slaughter_point` animal-product buyers, SIF plus SISBI (13,096),
`membership_muni` cooperative-member density (5,257), `gravity_catchment`
modelled silo draw-areas (3,103, the only `modelled` rows), and `mill_point`
sugar/ethanol mills (417).

providers.name: CONAB
providers.description: National grain warehouse registry (ArmazensCadastrados), the source of BR_intake_points.

providers.name: MAPA
providers.description: Federal meat and dairy inspection registry (SIF) and the SISBI system, the sources of BR_buyer_points and BR_sisbi_points.

providers.name: ANP
providers.description: Ethanol producer list, the source of BR_mill_points.

providers.name: IBGE
providers.description: Municipality boundaries and the Censo Agropecuario 2017, the sources of BR_muni and BR_membership_muni.

providers.name: Trase
providers.description: Compiled and geocoded the SISBI facility records reused in BR_sisbi_points.

providers.name: World Resources Institute
providers.description: Compiled, geocoded, unified and published the catalog.

BR_facilities.title: All facilities and membership, unified
BR_facilities.description: The unified layer: every entity as one row across all five tiers (32,309 points, 8,360 polygons). Start here.

table:columns.name: entity_id
table:columns.description: Identifier of the entity within its source registry. NOT unique: 40,669 rows carry 35,478 distinct values, and the namespace differs by tier.

table:columns.name: entity_kind
table:columns.description: cooperative | trader | official (silos) | buyer (slaughter/dairy) | mill.

table:columns.name: tier
table:columns.description: Layer this row belongs to: intake_point, slaughter_point, mill_point, membership_muni, or gravity_catchment.

table:columns.name: weight
table:columns.description: Size measure whose unit depends on tier: tonnes (silos), capacity band 1-4 (SIF), m3/day (mills), member count (membership).

table:columns.name: basis
table:columns.description: observed (recorded by an official source) or modelled (computed by us; only gravity_catchment).

table:columns.name: geom_method
table:columns.description: How the coordinate was set. One of registered, geocoded, municipality, derived, municipality_centroid.

table:columns.name: source
table:columns.description: Origin registry: CONAB, MAPA-SIF, Trase-SISBI, ANP, or IBGE-6848.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Geometry as WKB, WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Points for facilities; polygons for municipality and catchment rows.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: GeoParquet 1.1 covering column: the per-row envelope as xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax, so a reader can prune row groups without decoding geometry.
